routes.title: AlertUp — QR Code Evacuation Routes & Escape Maps
routes.description: Scan a QR code and instantly see the safest way out of any building. AlertUp turns official escape maps into instant evacuation routes — no app install.

content.h1: Scan once. Find the safest way out.
content.lead: AlertUp is a building safety platform that gives anyone instant access to evacuation routes through QR codes. Building owners upload their official escape and evacuation maps, generate a QR code for every floor and location, and print them around the building. When someone scans, they immediately see the safest path to an exit.
bullets: Emergency instructions — clear, step-by-step safety guidance tailored to the building and the type of emergency.
Escape route maps — simple visual evacuation maps showing exits and safe paths inside the building.
QR code access — no app needed; scan a code and instantly get emergency safety information.

routes.title: Scan a QR Code to Find Your Nearest Safe Exit
routes.description: Point your camera at an AlertUp QR code to open your building's evacuation route in seconds. Works in any mobile browser — nothing to download.

content.lead: Open the scanner, point your camera at any AlertUp QR code posted in a building, and you will be taken straight to that floor's evacuation route. The scanner runs in your browser — there is no app to install and no account required.
bullets: Works on any modern phone browser, online in seconds.
Only AlertUp codes are accepted — other QR codes are rejected.
Shows the floor map and the shortest safe path to the nearest exit.

faq.question: What is AlertUp?
faq.answer: AlertUp is a building safety platform that provides instant access to evacuation routes through QR codes. Building owners create a digital profile for their building, upload official escape and evacuation maps, and generate a QR code for each location. When a code is scanned, the person immediately sees the escape route to the nearest safe exit.

faq.question: Do I need to install an app to use AlertUp?
faq.answer: No. AlertUp runs entirely in your phone's browser. Scanning an AlertUp QR code opens the evacuation route for that floor straight away, with nothing to download and no account required.

faq.question: How do I add my building to AlertUp?
faq.answer: Create a free account, add your building and the number of floors, then upload the official evacuation map for each floor. AlertUp generates a printable QR code for every location that you can post around the building.

faq.question: What happens when someone scans an AlertUp QR code during an emergency?
faq.answer: The scan opens that floor's evacuation map and highlights the safest route from the scanned location to the nearest exit, together with step-by-step emergency instructions for the type of emergency in progress.

faq.question: Does AlertUp work without an internet connection?
faq.answer: Scanning a code requires an internet connection to load the building's current evacuation route, which is what lets the route reflect live emergency conditions such as a blocked exit.

faq.question: Is AlertUp free?
faq.answer: Creating an account and adding your first building is free. Larger buildings and advanced analytics are available on a paid plan.

howTo.name: How to find the safest exit with AlertUp
howTo.description: Use an AlertUp QR code to get the fastest safe route out of a building during an emergency.

steps.name: Find the nearest AlertUp QR code
steps.text: AlertUp codes are printed and posted around the building — usually near doors, lifts and stairwells.

steps.name: Scan it with your phone camera
steps.text: Point your camera at the code, or open alertup.world/scan and use the built-in scanner. No app installation is needed.

steps.name: Follow the highlighted route
steps.text: The floor's evacuation map opens with the safest path from your location to the nearest exit highlighted, along with emergency instructions.
